messages.subject: Introductory guide to Open Source and GSoC with R
messages.subject_clean: Introductory guide to Open Source and GSoC with R
messages.body_plain:
Based on my experiences while applying to and as a part of the GSoC program, and Open Source development, with the R project, I had penned down a blog post for potential participants.
Link to it on R-bloggers: http://www.r-bloggers.com/r-open-source-and-gsoc/
Hopefully, it might be helpful to some students and developers in the future.
